summary: Google DeepMind announced Gemini Robotics 2, a new family of vision-language-action, embodied-reasoning and on-device models that add whole-body humanoid control, advanced hand and gripper dexterity, multi-robot collaboration, and fast on-device adaptation to new robot embodiments.

mechanisms.reason: The document describes a first-time step change from tabletop manipulation to full whole-body humanoid control and multi-robot collaboration.
mechanisms.quote: For the first time, our model can now control entire humanoid robots, translating intent into intelligent whole-body control.

mechanisms.reason: A dedicated efficient VLA model is built to run inference locally on robotic devices rather than in a datacentre.
mechanisms.quote: Gemini Robotics On-Device 2 is built specifically to handle these constraints — it is our most-efficient vision-language-action model (VLA) optimized to run locally on robotic devices.

practices.reason: Teams building robotics or embodied-agent systems could evaluate the new whole-body control, multi-step task reasoning, and improved human-proximity safety behavior.
practices.quote: It observes the room, reasons about the steps needed to complete the task, coordinates with the VLA to carry out the actions, and tracks progress until the task is done.

practices.reason: A new agentic safety benchmark for robots is introduced that a team could adapt to test unsafe tool-call refusal and human-intervention requests.
practices.quote: We’re introducing ASIMOV-Agentic , a new benchmark for agentic safety orchestration and uncertainty resolution.

practices.reason: Availability changes (AI Studio, private preview on Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, early-access partner access) affect how a team would obtain and integrate these robotics models.
practices.quote: Gemini Robotics ER 2, our reasoning model, is now available on Google AI Studio and in private preview on Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform . Our VLA and On-Device models are available to early-access partners .

notable_reason: This is a first-of-its-kind demonstration of a single AI model family controlling full humanoid whole-body motion, fine dexterous manipulation, and multi-robot teamwork, a substantive capability step in physical AI.
